name: Broken Sea
description: Select a card from your Support Zone and discard it. Then all of your Simulanka Summons gain +1 Usage and +1 Effect.
descriptionraw: Select a card from your Support Zone and discard it. Then all of your $[K1035]s gain +1 Usage and +1 Effect.
